name: directorist-bulk-actions
description: **Directorist - Bulk Actions** is an extension for the popular [Directorist plugin](https://wordpress.org/plugins/directorist/) that allows users to perform bulk actions on their listings and taxonomies. This plugin is designed to streamline and simplify managing large numbers of listings by enabling bulk import-export of taxonomies, bulk deletion of listings and taxonomies, updating listing fields, and many more features.
